chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'I have seen that Allah, the Exalted, mentioned Riba (usury/interest) in more than one verse and repeated it.' So he (peace be upon him) said, 'Do you know why that is?' I said, 'No.' He (peace be upon him) said, 'So that people do not refrain from doing good deeds.'

key_terms.اصْطِنَاعِ: Making or doing, specifically referring to the act of performing or engaging in something.
key_terms.الرِّبَا: Usury or interest, a financial transaction involving excess or gain on a loan or debt.
key_terms.الْمَعْرُوفِ: Good deeds or righteous conduct, referring to permissible and virtuous actions in trade and life.
key_terms.غَيْرِ آيَةٍ: More than one verse, indicating repetition across multiple locations in the Quran.

ai.seo_question: Why did Allah repeat the word Riba in the Quran according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates that the Quranic repetition of 'Riba' is a divine precaution to prevent believers from becoming overly cautious and refraining from general righteous deeds (Ma'ruf) due to fear of inadvertently falling into usury. This interpretation highlights the balance between strict prohibition and the facilitation of lawful commerce, ensuring that the fear of riba does not paralyze economic activity. The hadith underscores the Shia scholarly view that legal rulings are designed to ease religious obligations rather than create undue hardship.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, form Usman Bin Isa, from Sama’at who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘I see that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the Exalted has Mentioned the interest in another Verse and Repeated it’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Or do you know why that is so?’ I said, ‘No’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Lest the people refrain from doing the good deeds’.
en.sarwar: 7. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from ‘Uthman ibn ’Isa from Sama‘ah who has said the following: “

I once said to abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘I have noticed that Allah, most High, has mentioned Riba’ in more than one passages of the Holy Quran. He (the Imam) asked, ’Do you know why He has done so?’ I (the narrator) replied, ’No, I do not know.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘It is because He wants people not to deny performing good and benevolent deeds.’”
